messages.subject: mqmplot.directedqtl
parts:
Has anyone encountered the following error when trying to use the mqmplot.directedqtl function?

Error in `[<-.data.frame`(`*tmp*`, , 3, value = c(0.0500175812521833,  : 
  replacement has 498 rows, data has 496
In addition: Warning message:
In onlymarkers[, 3] * (eff[, 3]/abs(eff[, 3])) :
  longer object length is not a multiple of shorter object length

Here is the code that produces this error,

esolidres<-mqmscan(esolidmultifilled,cofactors=esolidcofacs,pheno.col=3)
esolidres<-mqmextractmarkers(esolidres)
mqmplot.directedqtl(esolidmultifilled,esolidres,pheno.col=3)

It would seem that I am adding 2 rows to one of the objects at some point.  Not sure what I'm doing wrong.
Wondering if it has something to do with the cross being a selfed-RIL vs. an F2 cross in the example?

Thanks!
